convexity_probe.quantity: lowest gauge-orthogonal eigenvalue of second-order slice potential / 4 sin^2(pi/2N), on sampled fields

hessian_field.bound: Hess >= beta*(sum curl energy - (3072 r^2 + 192 r)*||X||^2); >= (2 beta/N^2)||X||^2 for flat-div-free X, r <= 1/(100 N^2)
hessian_field.scope: pointwise, along geodesics exp(tX)U at t=0; not reduced-potential convexity, not a statement about the measure
hessian_field.beta_needed_for_region_to_carry_measure: beta >~ N^14 log N, per measure_near_flat_threshold_estimate
hessian_field.decision: Brascamp-Lieb toy not pursued as a route to Target A: convexity threshold is a power of N even numerically; physical trajectory needs log N

covariant_block.bound: sup defect <= 1/(1000 L^2) => Hess + beta||div_U X||^2 + (beta/4L^2) sum||A_U X_mu||^2 >= (beta/16 L^2)||X||^2; independent of N and of distance from flat
covariant_block.scope: L2 operator bound on a quadratic form at U; no pointwise decay, no group block-spin constraint, no effective action
covariant_block.numerics_gap: no non-gauge far-from-flat small-defect background was tested; smooth backgrounds tried had defects 1.2-2.0

bad_set.scope: coercive on a subspace of small relative codimension uniform in N; excluded directions uncontrolled; fixed L; not a Poincare inequality

block_map.scope: worst-case deterministic; no statement about the blocked law
block_map.numerics: path product ratio tends to 2 (perimeter law); averaged maps approach 1; beta shift independent of beta through level 2, slope 0.129 not confirmed; see yang_mills_block_map_2026_10_30.json

block_law.scope: location of the blocked field on most links, uniform in volume; worst-case constants; no density, no effective action
